justification: k=2 was selected because it has the highest silhouette score (0.3400) among valid k values from 2 to 5. Silhouette close to 1 means tighter, better-separated groups; values near 0 mean overlapping groups. This is a compactness score, not proof that the groups exist in the field.
interpretation_note: Cluster labels describe similar input-feature profiles in this file. They are not verified real-world farm categories, risk grades, or operational types. Staff should treat them as a starting grouping, not as a confirmed identity for any collection point.
